set.body:
Single-developer-mode slice toward the PRD's D0/E0 path (2026-09-01-sherlock-recall-product-prd.md), owner-directed 2026-09-01: get recall transcripts mapping to video media coordinates ASAP.

Scope:
1. acquire (portable, shared src): SherlockAnnotationTable adapter -- verifies the admitted annotation TSV against inputAnnotation.sha256 (core pure Sha256), parses the 1000-row Microsegment1000 population with typed missing TRs (rows 481-482), scene grouping from the Scene Segments column, and binds the owner-established annotation-raw-to-part-playback-v1 crosswalk: rows 1-482 to media-part-a ticks, 483-1000 to media-part-b ticks, 1/2500 timebase, identity mapping seconds*2500, refusing escape/non-integer/foreign-hash input. Zero-duration row 13 becomes a typed PlaybackInstant, never a fabricated interval. Uses landed C1 contract types (SourceBundle.filmEdition, PlaybackInterval, RationalTimebase).
2. embed-bench (JVM diagnostic): bridge from the adapter's atlas to align.InMemorySourceView (leaves=microsegments on a derived description document, scenes=level-1 segments, succession/world order from film order, lemmas from description+names+location, polarity/modality Unknown -- honest, conflict rules only fire on known tags) plus recall CSV word-column ingestion and a terminal runner producing per-recall-unit MAP source anchors with exact media part + tick + second coordinates.

Deviations from D0 bead bd-01M1CQH3QNRMHZYR593DQWEBY7, decided single-dev (SD5): adapter is portable (pure bytes-in, no IO) rather than .jvm; TopicHmmEvent30, alias-map replay, d0-replay-receipt.json deferred; this is a diagnostic baseline per PRD section 1, not the E0 product. Real data stays in tmp/ (gitignored); committed fixtures are synthetic only, honoring fixture policy 14(d).
set.title: Sherlock recall-to-video mapping: portable annotation adapter, crosswalk binding, diagnostic bench runner
